config.name: ufd_qo_lora_reader_r16_full36_2048x4_l3_to_q4_seed1234
config.loss: Unchanged UFD full-vocabulary forward KL(Native||Writer+Reader), temperature1, FP32 loss; up to8 unique prediction positions, mean examples. No gold CE, choice KL, attention or KV loss.
config.prefix_sampling: Exact parent epoch order and positions. Epoch1 Native greedy; epochs2-4 exactly4 current Writer+Reader Student examples and4 Native examples per balanced batch. Student prefix sampling detached. Native Teacher always disables Reader.
config.interface: Frozen Stage-A and fixed UFD Stage-B step1024; unchanged Full-Sync, native anchor, native tail, chat, suffix, physical cache and absolute positions. Reader disabled during Native body/cache/Teacher computation; enabled only for translated-cache continuation including suffix and generation.
config.selection: Primary fixed epoch4/step1024. Keep epoch1/2/3/4 Reader checkpoints. Best macro validation KL checkpoint is diagnostic only, never test-selected.
config.validation_task_metrics: On fixed16 validation rows/task: KL plus same-prefix next-token agreement for all4 tasks; label accuracy on3 MCQ tasks. Full GSM8K free-generation accuracy only in final test, using unchanged4096 cap.
config.baseline_reuse: Reuse identity- and prompt-checked parent Qwen Native / old MCQ Writer / UFD Writer per-sample outputs. Compute only frozen UFD Writer+Reader. Require complete parent pipeline before GPU launch.

caveats: MMLU-Pro remains the approved CUSTOM split and label-scoring extension, not untouched official test.
Reader changes only continuation computation, never transmitted prefix KV. Future decoded KV can change indirectly.
Native greedy prefixes and64-token training horizon are unchanged from parent UFD. Formal GSM8K cap remains4096.
